Catalog-imported names and the DD sources their published entries listed

Read-only census. The population is 3150 standard names: the 1890 whose source_types contains catalog, plus every name their lineage reaches. Their published DD paths come from the standard-names catalog repository at every content commit at or before 2026-07-04T23:59:59 (66 commits), matched to DD 4 through the graph's RENAMED_TO records. Current holders are every name a StandardNameSource produces, whatever that holder's own status: skipping retired holders is what made a name's own producers read as lost. There are 5137 StandardName nodes in the graph.

Counts

Live names with their own published entry (1575 rows): carried 943, moved 122, stale source 90, pending composition 35, dropped 34, never sourced 351. Paths inside those rows: carried 2336, moved 301, stale source 172, pending composition 172, dropped 41.

Superseded names (1031 rows, counted apart so the live figures stand alone): carried 352, moved 164, stale source 135, pending composition 93, dropped 15, never sourced 272.

Inherited entries (544 names, counted apart and not in the headline): carried 219, moved 179, stale source 30, pending composition 38, dropped 78, never sourced 0. A name published no entry of its own, so its paths are its nearest publishing ancestor's whole list; counting those under the child would attribute a parent's sources to every descendant.

Counts are per name and split into three columns that are never mixed: live names with their own published entry (the headline), superseded names, and names whose entry is inherited from an ancestor. The inherited column is reported separately because a child inherits its parent's whole path list, which would otherwise attribute a parent's sources to every child.

Restricting live names to their import-time entry gives carried 964, moved 82, stale source 94, pending composition 33, dropped 5, never sourced 397. The two differ because a later entry can drop a path an earlier entry listed; a lost source is in scope under either publication, so the census unions them.

  • electrostatic_potential_at_midplane (ancestor of electrostatic_potential_at_outboard_midplane): class carried; published paths langmuir_probes/reciprocating/plunge/potential_plasma, langmuir_probes/reciprocating/plunge/v_plasma; expected moved before the locus retire landed; carried after it, because the plunge holder reached the name's descendant chain

The audit's exclusion

The export population selector at imas_codex/standard_names/export.py:668 reads name_predicate = "sn.name_stage IN ['accepted', 'approved']"; the classifier's live-name population excludes terminal status at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_supersession.py:3020 (terminal = ["deprecated", "superseded"]). electrostatic_potential_at_wall (stage reviewed, status draft) is excluded by the name-stage predicate: name_stage 'reviewed' is not accepted/approved, so _fetch_export_population excludes it before any source check. electrostatic_potential_at_midplane (stage superseded, status superseded) is excluded as terminal: status 'superseded' is terminal, so the classifier's live-name population excludes it.
